model.description: Nature's Heritage brings you Tropical & Citrus x Early Lemon Berry pre-rolls, a convenient 2-pack totaling 1g of premium flower. This exciting cross delivers a vibrant fusion of tropical fruit notes with bright citrus and zesty lemon berry undertones that awaken the senses. Each .5g pre-roll is expertly crafted for smooth, flavorful sessions whether you're at home or on the go. The exotic flavor profile features layers of sweet tropical fruits complemented by tangy citrus and refreshing lemon, creating a uniquely satisfying smoke. Perfect for cannabis enthusiasts seeking quality and convenience in one package, these pre-rolls showcase Nature's Heritage's commitment to premium flower and exceptional taste. Ideal for sharing or enjoying solo, this sample pack lets you experience bold, citrus-forward flavor with the trusted quality Nature's Heritage is known for.
